text:
leigh: Kickoff: StarterForge launch. Scope: tiny OSS refapp (chat + embeddings), short tutorial, reproducible bench kit, 30-min webinar (demo + live Q), and a gated 'starter playbook' for leads. Target: 800 dev signups, 150 live attendees.

ravi: Nice. Proposed dates?

leigh: Publish May 4, webinar May 20. Drafts due Apr 22.

claire: Bench plan: run baseline (cpu), small-gpu, and q4 quantized. I'll produce p50/p95 + cost/1k tokens. Need canonical prompt set.

noah: For the refapp repo keep it tiny: two services (api + frontend), docker-compose, and a single deploy button for hosted. README should have expected metrics.

mia: I'll write the tutorial and a compact slide deck. Can we standardize the sample dataset? maybe an FAQ dataset + a few docs.

ravi: Also include an ops sidebar: caching strategies (KV cache), batching knobs, and when to switch to Dedicated. One slide.

leigh: Messaging: headline focusing on "forkable starter for production inference." Subhead: "benchmarks you can run yourself." Avoid marketing fluff.

mia: Draft headline options:
- "Forkable LLM starter kit for engineers"
- "From repo to production: a tiny inference starter"

claire: Bench specifics: use seq lengths 64/256/512, include embeddings throughput and NN search latency. Will run Apr 12-15.

noah: Lead capture: gated 'Starter Playbook' PDF. Form should capture company size, role, and interest in Dedicated. Add a hidden utm_campaign=starterforge.

leigh: Owner roles: leigh (launch owner), mia (content + social), noah (repo + deploy), claire (bench), ravi (slides + messaging).

launch-bot: Checklist generated: https://ok.redwood/launch/starterforge (repo, tutorial, bench csv, slides, gated pdf, webinar slot).

mia: Social plan: 6-tweet thread, 2 short demo clips (30s), LinkedIn post, and partner outreach to 4 OSS newsletters. I'll draft copy by Apr 18.

noah: Repo notes: keep code examples < 12 lines, include quickstart with expected p50/p95 numbers, and an example workflow for local testing. I'll add a GH Action to run a smoke bench.

claire: Can we add a short 'how we measured' appendix in the blog (commands, hardware, docker image tags)? I want reproducibility.

ravi: Yes. Also include a 'cost-savings checklist' (quantize, KV cache, batching) as a callout.

leigh: Email nurture flow: immediate thank-you + playbook link, day3: bench highlights, day10: webinar reminder. Who builds templates?

james: (shared in DM) I'm out Apr 10-14 but can help with GA copy after Apr 18.

noah: I'll wire the form and hubspot fields by Apr 20. Add a checkbox: "Interested in Dedicated demos" to route to AEs.

mia: For webinar format: 8-min recorded demo, 10-min bench walkthrough, 10-min live Q. Keep it tight.

claire: I'll publish CSV + a small plot image for blog. Also attach raw results to the gated playbook.

leigh: Approvals: messaging + screenshots by Apr 24. If not approved, we delay publish.

mia: Draft social TL;DR: "New StarterForge kit: fork, deploy, and bench in minutes. Webinar May 20. RSVP: https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_campaign=starterforge :rocket:"

noah: Adding a small CONTRIBUTING.md so community can submit bench PRs.

launch-bot: Slack reminder scheduled: Apr 21 9am PT for final assets.

leigh: Great work. Let's keep the launch low-friction and highly reusable for the community. Drop updates here if timelines slip. :green_heart:
